description: Work out a deep-buttoned diamond layout: how many buttons, the marking grid on the base, the wider grid on the fabric, and the cut size of the cover. The fabric grid is always larger than the base grid because fabric has to travel down into each button pull — get that wrong and the panel is ruined. Use for buttoned headboards, Chesterfields, ottomans and buttoned chair backs.

area_height_cm.description: Height of the area to be buttoned.

area_width_cm.description: Width of the area to be buttoned, excluding any plain border.

border_cm.description: Plain unbuttoned border around the diamonds. Default 0.

depth.description: Button depth, which sets the fabric fullness. shallow 13 mm, medium 19 mm, deep 32 mm per diamond each way. Default medium.

diamond_height_cm.description: Roughly how tall you want each diamond.

diamond_width_cm.description: Roughly how wide you want each diamond. Gets adjusted to fit the area evenly.

turn_cm.description: Turnings to wrap the frame. Default 5 cm.

name: calculate_deep_buttoning
title: Calculate a deep-buttoning layout
